MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is pronounced nín hǎo? (1 mark)
   A. 呢
   B. 谢谢
   C. 您好
   D. 你

2. What kind of syllable pattern do bàba, māma and dìdi share? (1 mark)
   A. They have only one syllable
   B. A syllable is repeated
   C. They have three syllables
   D. They have no vowels

3. Which word is pronounced érzi? (1 mark)
   A. 是
   B. 儿子
   C. 女儿
   D. 这

4. Which Chinese word means "mother"? (1 mark)
   A. 妈妈 māma
   B. 那 nà
   C. 妹妹 mèimei
   D. 谁 shéi

5. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom."? (1 mark)
   A. 门在左边。
   B. 电视在桌子上。
   C. 电视在客厅。
   D. 床在卧室。

6. In the Swahili week, which day is counted as day 1? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Monday
   C. Friday
   D. Sunday

7. Which word means "gift"? (1 mark)
   A. 盘子
   B. 礼物
   C. 蜡烛
   D. 杯子

8. What does 早饭 (zǎofàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Spinach
   B. Apple
   C. Breakfast
   D. To drink

9. Which Chinese word means "spinach"? (1 mark)
   A. 米饭 mǐfàn
   B. 菠菜 bōcài
   C. 水果 shuǐguǒ
   D. 水 shuǐ

10. Which word is pronounced xǐhuan? (1 mark)
   A. 苹果
   B. 饼干
   C. 吃
   D. 喜欢

11. What does 耳朵 (ěrduo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Knee
   B. Ear
   C. Shoulder
   D. Tooth

12. Which sentence means "This is the sun."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天有云。
   B. 今天下雨。
   C. 雨很大。
   D. 这是太阳。

13. What does 今天天气很好 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Sunday
   B. It rains today
   C. The weather is very good today
   D. I am going to school

14. Which sentence means "The sofa is beside the door."? (1 mark)
   A. 浴室在花园旁边。
   B. 沙发在门旁边。
   C. 电视在客厅。
   D. 床在卧室。

15. Read the pinyin: zàijiàn! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello, teacher!
   B. My name is Xiaoming.
   C. Goodbye!
   D. Good morning!

16. What is the full stop in Chinese? (1 mark)
   A. 。
   B. ,
   C. 、
   D. ?

17. What does the apostrophe in nǚ'ér do? (1 mark)
   A. It shows where one syllable ends and the next starts
   B. It changes the tone
   C. It means a light tone
   D. It marks a question

18. Which is the short form of 星期? (1 mark)
   A. 学
   B. 周
   C. 家
   D. 去

19. Fill the blank: 我们切____。 (We cut the cake.) (1 mark)
   A. 礼物
   B. 快乐
   C. 蛋糕
   D. 朋友

20. What does 芒果 (mángguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Biscuits
   B. Coffee
   C. Mango
   D. To like

21. Which word means "snacks"? (1 mark)
   A. 零食
   B. 饮料
   C. 蔬菜
   D. 水果

22. Which sentence means "I like to eat bananas."? (1 mark)
   A. 我喝茶。
   B. 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   C. 这是香蕉。
   D. 这是什么?

23. Which sentence means "I use my mouth to speak."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用嘴巴说。
   B. 我用眼睛看。
   C. 我用耳朵听。
   D. 我有两只眼睛。

24. What does 用 (yòng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ear
   B. Two (before a counting word)
   C. Shoulder
   D. To use

25. Fill the blank: 今天____雨。 (Today it rains.) (1 mark)
   A. 在
   B. 上
   C. 下
   D. 好

26. Which Chinese word means "not"? (1 mark)
   A. 也 yě
   B. 不 bù
   C. 干旱 gānhàn
   D. 很 hěn

27. What does 你 (nǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I, me
   B. And you? (a question word)
   C. You
   D. Classmates

28. Which punctuation mark is a small circle at the end of a statement? (1 mark)
   A. 。
   B. ?
   C. 、
   D. !

29. Read the pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. There are five people in my family.
   B. That is my younger brother.
   C. Who is this?
   D. This is my father.

30. Which sentence means "The fridge is in the kitchen."? (1 mark)
   A. 冰箱在厨房。
   B. 床在卧室。
   C. 沙发在门旁边。
   D. 浴室在花园旁边。

31. Which Chinese word means "kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. 里 lǐ
   B. 旁边 pángbiān
   C. 厨房 chúfáng
   D. 东西 dōngxi

32. Which sentence means "Today is Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. 明天是星期一。
   B. 今天是星期三。
   C. 昨天是星期三。
   D. 今天是星期天。

33. What is a 田字格 used for? (1 mark)
   A. Drawing maps
   B. Writing characters neatly in a square with cross lines
   C. Cutting paper
   D. Counting money

34. What does 鼻子 (bízi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Head
   B. Eye
   C. Nose
   D. To speak

35. What does 牙 (yá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Shoulder
   B. Tooth
   C. To touch
   D. To look, to see

36. What is the last stroke written in 头? (1 mark)
   A. 捺 nà
   B. 横 héng
   C. 点 diǎn
   D. 撇 piě

37. Fill the blank: 今天有____。 (Today there is sun.) (1 mark)
   A. 雪
   B. 太阳
   C. 云
   D. 雨

38. What does 刮风 (guā fēng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. Not
   C. The wind blows
   D. Snow

39. Which Chinese word means "it rains"? (1 mark)
   A. 太阳 tàiyáng
   B. 刮风 guā fēng
   C. 天 tiān
   D. 下雨 xià yǔ

40. Which Chinese word means "left side"? (1 mark)
   A. 门 mén
   B. 东西 dōngxi
   C. 左边 zuǒbian
   D. 客厅 kètīng

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Compare how Mandarin and Kiswahili name family members. Give two similarities or differences. (4 marks)

42. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 三 and 什么. (2 marks)

43. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The rain is heavy." (2 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Saturday I rest at home." (3 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Thank you!" (2 marks)

46. Write a sentence asking when a friend's birthday is, and a sentence answering that your birthday is on 10 May. Include pinyin. (4 marks)

47. Explain how nǐ hǎo is really said, and why. (2 marks)

48. Explain how you can guess the meaning of 咖啡 in 我喝咖啡. (3 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My name is Xiaoming." (2 marks)

50. Write "Happy birthday to you" in characters and pinyin. (2 marks)

51. Write the Chinese words for head, hand and foot, with pinyin. (3 marks)

52. Give one challenge of writing Chinese and one way to overcome it. (2 marks)

53. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 脚 and 休息. (2 marks)

54. Write five sentences about body parts and what they do, with pinyin. (5 marks)

55. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛肉 and 女儿. (2 marks)

56. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛奶, 大 and 昨天. (3 marks)

57. Write a five-sentence weather diary for one week in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

58. Explain one way each of these family members might help you: 妈妈 and 哥哥. Then say one way you help them. (4 marks)

59. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 谢谢, 哭 and 星期三. (3 marks)

60. Read and translate: 冰箱在厨房。 Then write the question that asks where the fridge is. (3 marks)

61. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ ài nǐ. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 您好
   您好 is pronounced nín hǎo and means hello (polite).

2. B — A syllable is repeated
   Each word repeats a syllable, with a light second one.

3. B — 儿子
   儿子 is pronounced érzi and means son.

4. A — 妈妈 māma
   妈妈 (māma) means mother.

5. D — 床在卧室。
   床在卧室。 (chuáng zài wòshì.) means "The bed is in the bedroom.".

6. A — Saturday
   Jumamosi, Saturday, is day one, so Monday is day three (Jumatatu).

7. B — 礼物
   礼物 lǐwù is a gift.

8. C — Breakfast
   早饭 (zǎofàn) means breakfast.

9. B — 菠菜 bōcài
   菠菜 (bōcài) means spinach.

10. D — 喜欢
   喜欢 is pronounced xǐhuan and means to like.

11. B — Ear
   耳朵 (ěrduo) means ear.

12. D — 这是太阳。
   这是太阳。 (zhè shì tàiyáng.) means "This is the sun.".

13. C — The weather is very good today
   天气 is weather and 很好 is very good.

14. B — 沙发在门旁边。
   沙发在门旁边。 (shāfā zài mén pángbiān.) means "The sofa is beside the door.".

15. C — Goodbye!
   zàijiàn! is 再见!, which means "Goodbye!".

16. A — 。
   The Chinese full stop is a small circle.

17. A — It shows where one syllable ends and the next starts
   The apostrophe separates nǚ and ér.

18. B — 周
   周 zhōu means week and is used in 周一 and 周日.

19. C — 蛋糕
   蛋糕 is cake.

20. C — Mango
   芒果 (mángguǒ) means mango.

21. A — 零食
   零食 língshí is snacks.

22. B — 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   我喜欢吃香蕉。 (wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.) means "I like to eat bananas.".

23. A — 我用嘴巴说。
   我用嘴巴说。 (wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō.) means "I use my mouth to speak.".

24. D — To use
   用 (yòng) means to use.

25. C — 下
   下雨 means it rains.

26. B — 不 bù
   不 (bù) means not.

27. C — You
   你 (nǐ) means you.

28. A — 。
   That is the Chinese full stop.

29. A — There are five people in my family.
   wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. is 我家有五口人。, which means "There are five people in my family.".

30. A — 冰箱在厨房。
   冰箱在厨房。 (bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.) means "The fridge is in the kitchen.".

31. C — 厨房 chúfáng
   厨房 (chúfáng) means kitchen.

32. B — 今天是星期三。
   今天 is today.

33. B — Writing characters neatly in a square with cross lines
   It keeps characters even and centred.

34. C — Nose
   鼻子 (bízi) means nose.

35. B — Tooth
   牙 (yá) means tooth.

36. A — 捺 nà
   The order is 点, 点, 横, 撇, 捺.

37. B — 太阳
   太阳 is the sun.

38. C — The wind blows
   刮风 (guā fēng) means the wind blows.

39. D — 下雨 xià yǔ
   下雨 (xià yǔ) means it rains.

40. C — 左边 zuǒbian
   左边 (zuǒbian) means left side.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Similar: both repeat a syllable in words for close family, such as baba and bàba, mama and māma. Different: Mandarin has different words for older and younger brothers and sisters, but Kiswahili uses kaka and dada for both.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 三: sān, three. 什么: shénme, what.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 雨很大。 yǔ hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期六在家休息。 wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào? 我的生日是五月十号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì wǔ yuè shí hào.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is said like ní hǎo, because when two third tones come together, the first changes to a second tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the changed sound and 1 mark for the rule.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: The verb 喝 means to drink, so 咖啡 must be a drink. A picture can also help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verb clue, 1 mark for the conclusion, 1 mark for another clue.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: 头 tóu, 手 shǒu, 脚 jiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example, remembering stroke order; practise a few characters each day and use flashcards.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: 脚: jiǎo, foot. 休息: xiūxi, to rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。我用耳朵听。我用嘴巴说。我有两只手。我有两只脚。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng. wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī shǒu. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī jiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with correct pinyin.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: 牛肉: niúròu, beef. 女儿: nǚ'ér, daughter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: 牛奶: niúnǎi, milk. 大: dà, big. 昨天: zuótiān, yesterday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

57. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一,太阳很大。星期二,有云。星期三,下雨。星期四,风很大。星期五,太阳很大。 xīngqīyī, tàiyáng hěn dà. xīngqī'èr, yǒu yún. xīngqīsān, xià yǔ. xīngqīsì, fēng hěn dà. xīngqīwǔ, tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day with weather and pinyin.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: mum cooks and cares for us; an older brother helps with homework; I help by washing the dishes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each helper, 1 mark for how, 1 mark for your own help. Any sensible answer.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢: xièxie, thank you. 哭: kū, to cry. 星期三: xīngqīsān, Wednesday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: bīngxiāng zài chúfáng. The fridge is in the kitchen. Question: 冰箱在哪儿?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for translation, 1 mark for the question.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: I love you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.
